facts.en: Earned an animation production diploma at Fictional Fernframe College in 2024.
facts.zh: 2024 年在虚构蕨帧学院获得动画制作文凭。

facts.en: Paid production assistant at Fictional Cloudthimble Animation from 2024-07 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2026-08 在虚构云顶针动画公司任有薪制作助理。

facts.en: Updates assigned shot statuses from artists’ submissions and supervisor review notes.
facts.zh: 依据艺术人员提交内容及主管评审记录，更新分配到的镜头状态。

facts.en: Checks file naming, version numbers and expected frame ranges before routing material for review.
facts.zh: 在转交素材评审前检查文件命名、版本号及预期帧范围。

facts.en: Organizes review agendas and records the supervisor’s requested follow-up actions.
facts.zh: 组织评审议程，并记录主管要求的后续行动。

facts.en: The animation supervisor approves creative quality; the production manager approves delivery priorities.
facts.zh: 动画主管批准创作品质，制作经理批准交付优先次序。

facts.en: Supported a 2025-11 short-animation sequence containing 38 planned shots.
facts.zh: 支持一段 2025-11 动画短片序列，包含 38 个计划镜头。

facts.en: A review snapshot showed 24 shots approved, 9 awaiting review and 5 still in artist work.
facts.zh: 一份评审状态快照显示，24 个镜头获批、9 个待评审、5 个仍由艺术人员制作。

facts.en: That snapshot did not establish final delivery of all 38 shots or the candidate’s animation authorship.
facts.zh: 该快照未证明全部 38 个镜头最终交付，亦未证明动画由候选人创作。

facts.en: Personally maintained the review tracker and assembled version links; artists created the animation.
facts.zh: 个人维护评审跟踪表并汇集版本链接；动画由艺术人员创作。

facts.en: Uses a production tracker, shared file directories and spreadsheet status summaries.
facts.zh: 使用制作跟踪系统、共享文件目录及电子表格状态摘要。

facts.en: Completed an internal production-file workflow induction in 2024-07.
facts.zh: 2024-07 完成内部制作文件流程入职培训。

facts.en: For the diploma course, animated a personal 40-second bouncing-object exercise using Blender in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在文凭课程中使用 Blender 制作个人 40 秒弹跳物体动画练习。

facts.en: That exercise was assessed as coursework and was not a commissioned studio shot.
facts.zh: 该练习作为课程作业接受评核，并非受委托工作室镜头。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Pebblepuppet Student Festival in 2022, setting out programme leaflets.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构卵石偶学生节做志愿者，摆放节目单。

facts.en: Co-created a personal paper-character flipbook in 2025 with a friend; personally drew background shapes.
facts.zh: 2025 年与一名朋友共同制作个人纸角色翻页书；个人绘制背景形状。

facts.en: Enjoys designing imaginary creature silhouettes and playing cooperative puzzle games.
facts.zh: 爱好设计想象生物剪影及玩合作式解谜游戏。

facts.en: Flags missing submissions and unresolved version conflicts in daily production handovers.
facts.zh: 在每日制作交接中标记缺失提交内容及未解决版本冲突。

facts.en: No professional responsibility for rigging characters or approving rendered lighting is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录在职业工作中承担角色绑定或批准渲染灯光的职责。
